scope: All tracked fixture payloads, reference samples, generators and provenance/notice files in Tests/SwiftJXLCoreTests/Fixtures. Baseline hashes attest retained bytes, not independent codec correctness. Historical engineering archives are not redistributed test-resource qualification.

jpeg.scope: Authored synthetic JPEG images and derived coefficient/JBRD vectors; independent tools do not license their encoded output.

icc.scope: Generated profiles retain embedded text: No copyright, use freely. Generator and authored manifest use Apache-2.0.

jpeg-extended.scope: Authored synthetic JPEG/expected-sample cases; per-case generator provenance is retained.

jpeg-events.scope: Authored explicit entropy-bit vectors. The separate large-EOB cases retain their CC0 declaration.

large-eob.scope: Authored constant-image JPEG/JBRD fixture has its own CC0 declaration; it is not relicensed.

brotli.scope: Authored framing/compression vectors use Apache-2.0; dictionary-derived vectors retain Brotli MIT terms. Retaining both notices for the collection does not relicense its parts.

modular.scope: Synthetic predecessor numeric comparisons and independently generated Modular images. Subdirectory manifests record generators, samples, precision and hashes; no external media.

vardct.scope: Synthetic streams and numeric reference outputs. Nearest manifests and retained validation describe exact generators and oracle revisions. Official conformance assets are a separate group.

conformance.scope: Official grayscale source images are CC0; upstream allows test reproduction and retains BSD notice. Embedded ICC has its Adobe notice. Original terms remain; not Apache-2.0.
